CAVEAT, fails the strict sharpness bar: MAD50=1.80 native / 1.37 at 1800, and it only rises below ~1400 px, so it is a clean upscale of a ~1200-1300 px master (1:1 crop is smooth with no JPEG blocking). Still clearly better than Kobo (0.28) and the best-resolved JP vol. 1 file found; fine when downscaled to an 800 px card.
